productsLead: Take a pause, work through a choice, or learn about what you are feeling.

products.name: BRET
products.description: Choose a breathing pattern or follow progressive muscle relaxation. Make room for a short pause, at your own pace.

products.name: Decision Matrix
products.purpose: A clearer view of your options
products.description: Compare your options, then weigh the reasons for and against. A structured way to think through a choice.

products.name: TAPL
products.purpose: Small steps, at your own pace
products.description: A planned tool for habits, learning, and gradual progress. TAPL is in development and is not available to try yet.

resourcesLead: Start with a topic you want to understand. There is no required order, and you can choose a different resource at any time.

resources.title: Articles with audio
resources.description: Explore nine articles about sleep and burnout. Read at your own pace or listen on each article page.

resources.title: Self-assessment questionnaires
resources.description: Explore five questionnaires as a starting point for reflection. They offer questions to consider, not a diagnosis.
